findings.title: The all-or-nothing claim excludes write failures
findings.claim: The plan says a failed bless writes nothing, but the implementation writes the staged artifacts sequentially.
findings.why: If a later write fails, earlier artifacts have already changed. The mixed-version guard protects a retry, but the stated all-or-nothing behavior does not hold.
findings.fix: Qualify the claim as covering staging failures, or add a write procedure that can preserve the originals if any write fails.

prior.note: The plan stages all three artifacts before writing and checks every stored version. The mixed-version and third-stage-failure tests are specified at plan L236-L263; the guard and caller are at plan L288-L303 and L459-L484.
The checkout step is gone. Plan L963-L964 uses the supported --output-dir flag shown in scripts/determinism/run.ts:L14-L15 and L60-L64; the destination is git-ignored.
